lines.trans: Excuse me, who are you?
I'm Marina Sergeyevna. And these are my students.
Pleased to meet you. So what's the matter?

words.gram: adverb; очень приятно = pleased to meet you

lines.trans: Don't you know?
No, I don't.
Don't lie. They're pulling down the monastery wall!
They want to build a shopping centre there.
That can't be. It's our history.
How strange, I've heard nothing about it.

words.gram: genitive, with не on the verb (double negative)

lines.trans: Pavel Yuryevich, what is this?

words.gram: first name, nominative, used as address
nominative singular, neuter; что такое = what is

lines.trans: We just didn't want to bother you. We'll cancel it all!
Marina, I promise you: nothing will happen to the wall.

words.gram: genitive, with не on the verb (double negative)

lines.trans: All right. My students and I will keep an eye on it.

words.gram: preposition + instrumental; мы со студентами = my students and I

words.gloss: will keep an eye on it

lines.trans: That's right. I'm inviting you onto the public council.
Thank you, Marina. Sorry, I'm in a hurry.
Pasha, I don't want to hear about her again. Understood?

words.gram: short first name, used as address
past, masculine singular, perfective; = got it?

lines.trans: I'll take care of it.
And don't drag your feet with the shopping centre!
